milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to the oak structure and visually locate the yellow bed inside. Target is the bed's foot position at spawn-relative (10, 1, 10), matching the /setblock ~10 ~1 ~10 command. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to have genuinely found the bed (inside the structure or at the doorway, which is ~2 blocks from the bed). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking toward the bed, not just standing nearby facing away. This rule type was chosen over position_inside_box because find tasks should verify the player can see the target, not just that they reached a location.
